elements.element: Transition assistance triggered on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: "Upon any termination of this Agreement (in its entirety or with respect to any country or other jurisdiction)" — expiry of the Term is not covered, and the duties only arise "at AbbVie's request"

elements.element: Transition assistance for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: "provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months following the effective date of such termination"

elements.element: Transition assistance priced at then-current rates
elements.evidence: "at AbbVie's cost" — no "then-current rates" standard is stated, leaving the charging basis open

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: "(b) within thirty (30) days of such request, return to AbbVie" — the 30 days runs from a later request, not from expiry or termination, and the whole obligation is gated on "at AbbVie's request"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: "in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all data and Information of AbbVie in Harpoon's possession or Control"
"(c) thereafter delete such data and Information from its systems (subject to Section 9.7)"
"and certify such deletion in writing to AbbVie"
"up to six (6) months following the effective date of such termination" exceeds 90 days
"within thirty (30) days of such request, return to AbbVie, in a commonly used, machine-readable format"

offending_extra_words: provided that AbbVie may retain one (1) copy of, and shall not be required to destroy, any such data or Information to the extent reasonably necessary to comply with Applicable Law (including Section 3.8.5) or its pharmacovigilance obligations, or for litigation or archival purposes
to enable the orderly wind-down or transfer of AbbVie's activities hereunder (including with respect to Regulatory Documentation, safety data and ongoing clinical trials)
reasons: Preferred level fails on pricing: the drafter wrote "at AbbVie's cost" rather than the playbook's "then-current rates"; insert "at Harpoon's then-current rates" to close this.

Preferred level fails on the return trigger and deadline: the 30 days runs "of such request" and the whole wind-down obligation is conditioned on "at AbbVie's request", so a mandatory post-termination return within 30 days of expiry or termination is not secured. Change to "within thirty (30) days after the effective date of expiry or termination" and drop the request gate for limb (b).
The trigger omits expiry — "Upon any termination" should read "Upon expiry or termination" to match the position.

Minimality fails: operation 1 rewrites 9.7(c) from 29 to 83 words, adding a broad new retention carve-out (Applicable Law, pharmacovigilance, litigation and archival purposes) that duplicates the retention protections already in 9.7(a)-(b) and is not needed to complete the transition rule. The 30-day/machine-readable point could be added with a short phrase.

The inserted 12.6.6 also carries unnecessary descriptive boilerplate ("to enable the orderly wind-down or transfer of AbbVie's activities hereunder (including with respect to Regulatory Documentation, safety data and ongoing clinical trials)") beyond what the rule requires.
Unrelated terms (12.10.2 sell-off, payment obligations, 9.7(a)-(b) mechanics) are untouched and remain effective; verify the cross-reference to "Section 3.8.5" so no dangling reference is introduced.
Net effect: the clause now sits at the fallback (90+ days assistance and 30-day machine-readable export) but does not reach the locked preferred target.
